kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أبتكر (form VIII)
# أَبْتَكِرُ (ʔabtakiru) /ʔab.ta.ki.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# أُبْتَكَرُ (ʔubtakaru) /ʔub.ta.ka.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# أَبْتَكِرَ (ʔabtakira) /ʔab.ta.ki.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# أُبْتَكَرَ (ʔubtakara) /ʔub.ta.ka
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
